raw_response:
This year I am planting maize again on my main plot here in Mangochi. I am hoping to get a fertilizer coupon from FISP like last season — if it comes, I will use NPK at planting and urea for top-dressing, but I cannot afford to buy much extra at market price. I always put some manure from my goats around the planting stations because it helps the soil, and I intercrop with pigeon pea to get something more from the same land. I will use hybrid seed if the coupon covers it, otherwise I recycle some grain from last year mixed with a little bought seed. I do most of the work with my wife and older children, and only hire a few people for weeding when the rains are heavy and the weeds grow too fast.
